title: The lab: every crop stage, placeable, machine, node and forage good
about: The debug-only developer map. West bed: one crop per row, seed to ripe; east bed: more crops, then tilled, watered, fertilized, weeds and bare dirt. Machines and decor line the road, animal houses sit north-west, ore nodes in the quarry (north-east), forage on the west meadow, water along the south shore. The house door teleports to the shore. Villagers stand on the north road.
